mapsToSemantics: index 0.0 -> 26.4 C (a typical July night: the mean daily minimum); index 1.0 -> 32.7 C (a typical July afternoon: the mean daily maximum). A display band the relative index is read against, not a site measurement.

source.name: Hong Kong Observatory open data - Lau Fau Shan (LFS) daily air-temperature record
source.licence: Hong Kong Observatory open data (GovHK Terms of Use); free, no key
source.method: Mean of the daily minimum and daily maximum air temperature over July of 2015-2024, from the LFS daily station record. Missing values use the HKO sentinel '***' and are excluded, never coerced to 0. rangeC = [mean(daily min), mean(daily max)].

crossChecks.name: HKO 1991-2020 climate normals (HKO Headquarters)
crossChecks.note: A different product (a 30-year normal at HKO HQ), used only to show the LFS July band is ordinary for Hong Kong. NOT the anchor.

crossChecks.name: Open-Meteo ERA5 archive (reanalysis) at the site centroid
crossChecks.note: An independent reanalysis cross-check, within 1.8 C of the LFS band maximum. NOT the anchor.

whatThisIsNot: This is a stated air-temperature band for a Hong Kong summer, NOT a measurement of the Hung Shui Kiu / Ha Tsuen site. The LFS station is ~20 km away and this is a 10-year July climatology, not the site's air temperature on any day.

This is AIR temperature, not skin (surface) temperature. Landsat/MODIS/ECOSTRESS LST runs 10-20 C above air on a hot paved surface and was unreachable (credential-gated) from this host. The two quantities are never conflated.
The heat field stays a relative 0-1 index. This band is what the index is READ AGAINST; the field is never converted to degrees Celsius.
The HEAT_INDEX land-class table remains hand-authored and unverified; the anchor does not change it.
